subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

The government's __utilitarian__ stance was appreciated by all.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Useful**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word '**utilitarian**' means practical or useful. (व्यावहारिक या उपयोगी)
 
• Synonyms for 'utilitarian' include functional, pragmatic, and efficient.
 
 
• **For example**: *The utilitarian design of the building prioritizes function over aesthetics.*
 
 
 
• So, in this context '**useful**' is the most appropriate synonym for the highlighted word.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Thrust **means a forceful push or a main theme. (एक जोरदार धक्का या मुख्य विषय)
 
• **Fanciful **means imaginative or unrealistic. (कल्पनाशील या अवास्तविक)
 
• **Distasteful **means unpleasant or offensive. (अप्रिय या आपत्तिजनक)
